attributes.action: Introduce a price cap for domestic heating oil
attributes.additional_details: Homes where there are no gas mains, may typically rely on heating oil (kerosene) for their heating and hot water. Unlike gas and electricity, the price of heating oil is not protected by price caps - domestic users of heating oil should be afforded the same protection from wild market fluctuations as domestic gas and electricity consumers.
attributes.background: Introduce a price cap per litre for domestic heating oil to protect consumers from price spikes, similar to those for gas and electricity.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784545
